name: io.github.raristotle/meridian-product-finder
description: AI product recommender for electrical distributors — search, cross-reference, product detail, availability, jobs, and ordering tools over the Meridian/Wesco catalog. Read tools are free; create_job/place_order are write tools gated by the deployment's API token.

environmentVariables.name: MERIDIAN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required for the write tools when the deployment's WRITE_API_TOKEN gate is enabled.
